name: @cotal-ai/connector-codex
description: Cotal connector for the OpenAI Codex CLI: a Node shim owns the mesh agent and drives codex exec turns, with the cotal_* tools served over local streamable HTTP MCP.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && pnpm run bundle
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.js --external:@cotal-ai/core && esbuild src/serve.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/serve.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cotalCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cotalCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
